name: County Superintendent Student Advisory Council
what_you_do: Share your views on schools with the County Superintendent at meetings through the school year. You can present at County Board of Education meetings and go on school visits.
who_can_apply: High school students from schools across Santa Barbara County. Past members came from Lompoc, Orcutt, Santa Barbara, Santa Maria, Santa Ynez Valley and Carpinteria high schools.
duration: One-year term that matches the school year
deadline_text: No 2026-27 dates are posted. The linked 2025-26 form is closed as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: The form on the council page is for 2025-26 and is closed. Ask the County Education Office when the next one opens.
notes: Confirm first: no ages, selection steps or deadline on the page. Past and current members are listed by district and school.
